scope: Round41 Europe lane handoff. Lane-reported findings, preserved so later rounds do not repeat them. Hashes refer to ignored local captures under tmp/research-round41-europe; findings were not root-verified beyond this summary.

candidates.name: Google Kronstorf Data Center, Austria
candidates.status_findings: The operator site (published by Volo zwei GmbH) says the centre is currently being built, but the homepage is undated. Kronstorf's municipal newsletter 4/2026, dated June 15, reports only the April 23 groundbreaking, which is before the window. The Upper Austria FAQ is undated and says stage 1 permits are granted and stage 2 permits are pending.
candidates.locator_findings: OSM way 1415615035 version 4, dated 2026-08-12, is named 'Google Rechenzentrum' and tagged landuse=construction. It has 84 nodes over about 29 ha. Versions 1-2 were tagged as a dm distribution centre until a March 2026 retag, and the current dm way 1492579812 is a separate polygon. The December 16, 2025 trade permit issued by BH Linz-Land grants Volo zwei GmbH a data centre on named KG Stallbach and KG Kronstorf parcels beside the L571; parcel geometry was not bound.
candidates.next_step: A dated Google, Volo zwei or Upper Austria statement of current physical work published between May 22 and August 20; root review of the OSM retag history before any locator use.

candidates.name: Microsoft Høje-Taastrup datacenter, Denmark
candidates.finding: Microsoft's July 2026 economic-impact PDF (sha256 273976278992c000f8af7c5d8f0e830ae970508e06a3d3192da702f47e61d678) says a Høje-Taastrup datacenter is under construction, but it has month precision, cites December 2025 data, and does not identify which building. OSM way 1355695031 is named CPH07, and no primary source binds that name.
